downstreams from lymphocyte_distribution_features

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)       
library(ggplot2)      
library(cluster)      
library(factoextra)  
library(dbscan)       
library(mclust)       

lymphocyte_features <-  fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/lymphocyte_distribution_features/feature_summaries/lymphocyte_feature_summaries_labl_2020_tuning_included_fragments_new.json")

fixed <- c("image_name", "fragment_name", "mucosa_name")

lymphocyte_features <- lymphocyte_features %>% 
  select(
    all_of(fixed),
    all_of(sort(setdiff(names(.), fixed))
  ))

# ── 1. pull & pre-process the vector ──────────────────────────────────
x <- lymphocyte_features |>                     # your data frame
       pull(villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um ) |>
       na.omit() |>                             # remove missing values
       scale() |>                               # zero-mean, unit-sd
       as.numeric()                             # strip attributes

# (Optional) glimpse distribution
ggplot(data.frame(x), aes(x)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40)

# Wrap in a 1-column data.frame if a function needs it
df1 <- data.frame(x)

```
#K- means
```{r}
## choose k ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(123)
fviz_nbclust(df1, kmeans, method = "wss")          # elbow (within-SS)
fviz_nbclust(df1, kmeans, method = "silhouette")   # average silhouette
gap <- clusGap(df1, FUN = kmeans, nstart = 25,
               K.max = 10, B = 50)                 # gap statistic
fviz_gap_stat(gap)

## fit with chosen k (replace 3 below with what you decide)
km <- kmeans(x, centers = 6, nstart = 50)
lymphocyte_features$kmeans_cluster <- km$cluster

fviz_cluster(km, X,
             stand = FALSE,        # already scaled
             geom  = "point",      # "point" or "text"
             show.clust.cent = TRUE)   # draws the centroids

```

# Db scan

```{r}
## pick eps with k-NN-distance plot (minPts ~ 2*dim ⇒ 4) --------------
kNNdistplot(df1, k = 4)
abline(h = 0.25, lty = 2)        # set to the “elbow” height you see

## fit DBSCAN
db <- dbscan(df1, eps = 0.25, minPts = 4)
lymphocyte_features$dbscan_cluster <- db$cluster   # 0 = noise

fviz_cluster(db, X)
```






# mean and sd (log_lc_dist)
```{r}
X <- lymphocyte_features %>%
  select(villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um) %>%
  na.omit() %>%           # drop rows with any NA in either column
  scale()                 # zero-mean, unit-sd for each feature

# keep row indices if you need to map clusters back later
row_map <- attr(X, "scaled:center")  # optional bookkeeping
```

k-means
```{r}
# --- pick k with gap statistic (or elbow/silhouette) -------------
set.seed(123)
gap <- clusGap(X, FUN = kmeans, nstart = 25, K.max = 10, B = 50)
fviz_gap_stat(gap)                       # visual
k_opt <- maxSE(gap$Tab[ , "gap"],
               gap$Tab[ , "SE.sim"], method = "firstSEmax")

# --- final fit ----------------------------------------------------
km <- kmeans(X, centers = k_opt, nstart = 50)

lymphocyte_features$kmeans_cluster <- NA    # pre-fill
lymphocyte_features$kmeans_cluster[as.numeric(rownames(X))] <- km$cluster

```

#DBSCAn
```{r}
# ---- Determine eps via k-NN distance plot ------------------------
minPts <- 4                     # 2 × dimensions (2×2)
kNNdistplot(X, k = minPts)
abline(h = 0.25, lty = 2)       # choose the “elbow” height

db <- dbscan(X, eps = 0.25, minPts = minPts)

lymphocyte_features$dbscan_cluster <- NA
lymphocyte_features$dbscan_cluster[as.numeric(rownames(X))] <- db$cluster

fviz_cluster(db, X)

```
